title: Tilt Fruit Drop
tagline: Drop, tilt, and merge fruits to the legendary watermelon.
description: Tilt Fruit Drop is a 3D physics merge puzzle for short browser sessions. Drag your finger to aim, tap to drop, and watch fruits stack and bounce inside a hexagonal glass jar. When two identical fruits touch they merge into the next one in the chain — cherry, strawberry, grape, tangerine, lemon, apple, peach, pineapple, honeymelon, pumpkin, and finally the legendary watermelon. The twist that sets this game apart from every other Suika-style fruit merge clone is the tilt mechanic: tap the bottom-left or bottom-right corner of the screen to physically tip the jar, sliding fruits sideways to set up combos or rescue a doomed pile. One round lasts one to three minutes — perfect for a coffee break — but the score chase is endless. Play instantly in your portrait mobile browser, install as a PWA on your home screen, and never lose your high score.

controls.en: Drag to aim, tap to drop. Tap bottom corners to tilt the jar.
controls.ja: ドラッグで狙ってタップで落下、左右コーナーをタップして瓶を傾ける。

engineNotes: Next.js 16 + React Three Fiber + drei + postprocessing + @react-three/rapier
